title: OmniBachi CC Pipeline Step Schema V0
description: JSON Schema for a single execution topology step within a Capability Contract pipeline. Each step is self-describing: it declares its identity, capability reference, I/O contracts, and routing inline. No global binding registry. No implicit chaining.

step.description: Unique step identifier within this CC pipeline. Used as dataflow address in $.results.<step_id>.* references by downstream steps.

transform.description: FQDN of the Capability Transform (CT) bound at this step. Exactly one of transform or side_effect MUST be present.

side_effect.description: FQDN of the Capability Side Effect (CS) bound at this step. Exactly one of transform or side_effect MUST be present.

op.description: Operation name to invoke on the bound CT or CS artifact.

additionalProperties.description: JSONPath expression. MUST reference $.inputs.* (CC-level input) or $.results.<step_id>.* (prior step output). No forward references. No ambient state.

inputs.description: Explicit input bindings for this step. All input sources must be declared.

additionalProperties.description: JSONPath expression sourcing a field from the capability result ($.capability_result.*).

outputs.description: Explicit output bindings mapping capability result fields to step output fields.

on_success.description: Status code produced when the capability execution succeeds.

on_failure.description: Status code produced when the capability execution fails.

on_ct_result.description: Maps the capability-level binary result (success/failure) to CC result status codes.

additionalProperties.description: Routing action: continue to next step or exit the CC with this status.

on_result.description: Step routing map. MUST contain an entry for every status code declared in the CC result_status_contract.allowed list. Values are exactly: continue or exit.

$comment: TOPOLOGY INVARIANT: each step MUST reference exactly one capability (transform XOR side_effect). Both present or neither present are constitutional violations per INVARIANT_TOPOLOGY_CAPABILITY_REFERENCE_UNIQUE_V0.
